address: Carretera Camprodón N 260, La Vall de Bianya, 17813, Spain
bio: This bright, welcoming restaurant just 100m or so from its elder sibling, the award-winning Ca l'Enric, is run by chef Isabel Juncà, who shares her passion for seasonally inspired traditional cuisine through affordably priced day-to-day cooking that definitely does not skimp on flavour. The à la carte, featuring savoury rice dishes, grilled fish and meat, and delicious cannelloni, is complemented by different seasonal suggestions plus an inexpensive yet well-crafted weekday menu. One dish that we can highly recommend, the finishing touches to which are added at your table, is the ajoblanco with a tartare of anchovies and strawberries....
